description: Lead with grace and understanding that is how we capture who we are at the core. #selflove #grace #selfpeace
transcript: You can be in the same environment with someone and be having a very, very different experience and that's why it's important to lead with grace. And everything that I do, I will always give the gift of grace, not to the detriment of myself of course. We need to fall back. We need to relinquish our need to control others. That is not our responsibility. We have to allow people, places and things to be what they are. Doing that, that's how we get in the mirror image of who we are at the core. Allow things to just be.
